camel_example: aliyun live CreateRTCWhipStreamAddress --region cn-hangzhou --AppId '6a0006dcc-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-e00e3exxxxxx' --UserId zb000000000001 --DisplayName '主播小二' --ClientToken '58E73333-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx' --ChannelId ch000000000001 --ExpireTime 43200
description_en: Creates a WHIP ingest URL for an ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication channel by calling CreateRTCWhipStreamAddress
kebab_example: aliyun live create-rtc-whip-stream-address --client-token 58E73333-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx --app-id 6a0006dcc-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-e00e3exxxxxx --channel-id ch000000000001 --user-id zb000000000001 --display-name '主播小二' --expire-time 43200 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRTCWhipStreamAddress

parameters.help_en:
The idempotency parameter.
> This parameter is used to identify whether multiple requests are the same request. We recommend that you do not specify this parameter for this operation
parameters.help_zh:
幂等参数。
> 用于区分多次请求是不是同一个请求的标识，针对本接口不建议填写
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can view your application IDs by navigating to **ApsaraVideo Live > Live+ > ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication > Application Management**. If no application exists, create one by clicking **Create Application**
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过访问 **视频直播>直播+>实时音视频>应用管理** 可以查看拥有的应用 ID，没有时可以通过【创建应用】进行新建
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel to join
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID. The user ID must be unique within the channel
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID，不能与频道中的其他用户 ID 重复
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the user in the channel.
> Chinese characters and other characters are supported. To avoid excessively long names, keep the size under 32 bytes
parameters.help_zh:
在频道中显示的用户名称。
> 支持填写中文等字符，为避免名称过长，大小建议小于32个byte
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the ingest URL. Unit: seconds. Default value: 43200.
> If the validity period expires, an ongoing stream that uses the URL generated by this operation is not affected. However, a new stream ingest attempt using the same URL will fail
parameters.help_zh:
推流有效时长，单位：秒，默认为43200秒。
> 若超过设置的有效期，则正在使用由本接口所生成地址进行的推流不受影响，但是用该地址重新推流则会失败
parameters.name: expire_time
